en.topic_title: Jailed activist Joshua Wong to plead guilty, face second national security jail term in September
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong is set to plead guilty and face sentencing for a foreign collusion charge in September, marking his second conviction under the national security law.



Joshua Wong, former secretary general of the now-disbanded political group Demosisto. Photo: Etan Liam, via Flickr.
